texts.error.no_battery: This cartridge has no battery-backed memory, so it keeps no saved games, and '%1' would not be read.
texts.error.no_file: No cartridge file is in the project.
texts.error.not_nes: '%1' is not an NES game. This core runs NES games only.
texts.firmware.ymf288.about: The 8 KB of drum sounds inside the YM2608 and YMF288 sound chips, which the EPSM's drums play. It is the same data as the file ym2608_adpcm_rom.bin. It is needed only when EPSM Drums is On.
texts.setting.epsm_drums.about: The EPSM is a sound chip some new games for the NES use. Its drums play sounds kept in the chip's own memory, and Mesen needs a copy of that memory, the YMF288 rhythm ROM, to play them. On asks for that file. Off plays the drums silent. The game's music and sound effects play either way. It changes the sound only.
texts.setting.expansion.about: What is plugged into the expansion port on the front of the Famicom, the Japanese console. The Famicom Zapper and the Famicom Arkanoid controller are the Japanese versions of the Zapper and the Arkanoid controller. The four-player adapter holds four controllers, for Japanese games made for four players. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.port1.about: What is plugged into the console's first controller port. The Four Score takes both ports and holds four controllers, for games made for four players; the second port is then not used. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.port2.about: What is plugged into the console's second controller port. The Zapper is the light gun; the Arkanoid controller is a knob with one button, made for the game Arkanoid. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.ram.about: What the console's memory holds when it is switched on. A real console starts with values nobody chose, and a few games behave differently because of them. Random fills it from the Random Seed below. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.region.about: Which console the game runs on: an American or Japanese NTSC NES (60 frames a second), a European PAL NES (50), or a Dendy (the Russian clone, 50). Auto takes the cartridge's header or Mesen's game database. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.seed.about: The number the random values start from, when Memory at Power On is Random. The same number gives the same values every time. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.rom.help: The NES cartridge file: .nes (iNES or NES 2.0) or .unf (UNIF). A game for the EPSM sound chip says so in its NES 2.0 header, and Mesen then plugs the EPSM in.
texts.slot.savedata.help: The saved game that a cartridge with battery-backed memory starts with. This is the file that Emulator > Export Save Data... writes (battery.sav). Leave this empty to start with a fresh cartridge.
texts.suggest.epsm: The cartridge's header says it uses the EPSM sound chip, so EPSM Drums is suggested On. It needs the YMF288 rhythm ROM.
texts.suggest.no_epsm: The cartridge's header does not ask for the EPSM sound chip. There is nothing to suggest.
texts.suggest.not_ines: The cartridge file has no iNES header, so there is nothing to suggest.
